name: fenn-search
title: Fenn Search
description: Search text in videos, spoken words in audio, and content inside Sketch files and documents with Fenn.
author: thoddnn

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Fenn
commands.description: Find content inside videos, audio, Sketch files, and documents. Switch search modes and filter file types. Requires Fenn 1.3.3 or newer and a valid Fenn license.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Fenn API Token
preferences.description: Leave empty for normal setup. Open Fenn 1.3.3 or newer and the connection is configured automatically. This is not your Fenn license key.
